nodes.name: go-classes-coa-test-2-photos.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression-tests the second GO Classes COA screenshot archive by verifying all fifteen questions use bundled answer-free practice images while retaining separate full attempt receipts. It also checks that the follow-up migration writes practice-image paths, never result-receipt paths, into re-attempt and journal image fields.
nodes.languageNotes: Vitest combines a dynamic JSON import with direct filesystem and migration-text assertions to validate both generated content and repository assets.
